Horizon holds no evidence from this recording, so no answer can cite it.

No transcript or caption file for this video exists in the repository, and the file itself carries no subtitle stream. The evidence below therefore comes from the labelled sample fixture — a synthetic retry-and-backoff lesson with its own short timeline. The fixture is not this video, and nothing here presents its text, its timestamps or its answers as though it came from this recording.

Video-grounded Q&A is therefore unavailable, not merely unverified: a question about what the instructor says in this recording cannot be answered from it.
